info.title: Omnichannel API
info.description:
Provides methods for sending single and batched outbound messages to any
configured channel, as well as posting inbound messages and message or
inbound status updates. Also supports retrieval, patching, and deletion of
individual messages, enabling full lifecycle management of omnichannel
communications.
